package com.itextpdf.io;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * This class is a wrapper for the java.io.RandomAccessFile class.
 */
public class com.itextpdf.io.RandomAccessFile extends RandomAccessFile {

    /**
     * Creates a new RandomAccessFile object, opening a file with the given
     * name for reading and writing. If the file does not already exist,
     * an attempt is made to create it.
     *
     * @param name the name of the file to be opened
     * @throws java.io.FileNotFoundException if the file specified by the
     *                                       given abstract pathname does not exist, is a directory
     *                                       rather than a regular file, or for some other reason
     *                                       cannot be opened for reading and writing
     * @throws java.io.AccessDeniedException if a file with the given name
     *                                       exists but cannot be opened for writing
     */
    public com.itextpdf.io.RandomAccessFile(String name) throws IOException {
        super(name);
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new RandomAccessFile object, opening a file with the given
     * name for reading and writing. If the file does not already exist,
     * an attempt is made to create it.
     *
     * @param file the file to be opened
     * @throws java.io.FileNotFoundException if the file specified by the
     *                                       given abstract pathname does not exist, is a directory
     *                                       rather than a regular file, or for some other reason
     *                                       cannot be opened for reading and writing
     * @throws java.io.AccessDeniedException if a file with the given name
     *                                       exists but cannot be opened for writing
     */
    public com.itextpdf.io.RandomAccessFile(File file) throws IOException {
        super(file);
    }
}
